WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.dealedge AS side,
    f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) AS group_avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY orderslink, side
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    side,
    group_avg_net_fee_rate,
    record_count,
    group_avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(group_avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS difference_from_side_avg,
    AVG(group_avg_net_fee_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  side,
  group_avg_net_fee_rate,
  record_count,
  difference_from_side_avg
FROM scored
WHERE group_avg_net_fee_rate > side_avg
ORDER BY difference_from_side_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The record count counts eligible fee rows, including rows whose rebate is missing; AVG ignores their NULL net fee rates, as requested.
